purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for the Ash-Halo answer-roll opening fixture.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for the Ash-Halo furnace court, ordinary threshold preparation, the face before the opening, the bounded request, second-horn custody, and branch-state aftermaths.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for court establishment, threshold work, the preparation affordance, the first-horn face, answer response, roll opening, bounded request, second-horn record position, and each ending family. The upward water and first face receive a pivotal frame before the player acts.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt supplies complete visible geometry, material, light, and character appearance for a general image model. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints; prompt assembly uses only visible refs plus triggered state or branch deltas.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Hand-painted high-fantasy interactive-fiction illustration, gouache and ink on textured paper, strong readable silhouettes, monumental basalt and iron geometry, ember orange and cold mineral teal light, restrained numinous strangeness, tactile work-worn materials, abstract unlettered record marks, humane faces under institutional pressure.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each image prompt from the global_style_cue, the complete scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters or groups listed as visible in that frame, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Exclude off-frame refs and continuity notes. Each render uses the fixture style cue and its camera-specific scene_set description as the complete geometry and art-direction input.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture includes a durable plan-level map of the rectangular court, two stairs, furnace wall, fitting dais, racks, threshold, quench route, and fixed camera slots. It is sufficient for B-level replay staging.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: For high-consistency website art, convert this plan into a simple hand-built blockout with the named camera and staging slots before image generation.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide establishing view from the northwest corner of a long rectangular underground furnace court built from soot-dark basalt. Four open furnace mouths glow along the east wall. Marked iron racks surround a low circular fitting dais at center, holding iron scales, copper wire, pale ceramic splints, resin jars, charcoal baskets, and quench buckets. Heavy counterweight tracks cross the high ceiling. A long stone quench trough runs along the south wall to a grated channel beside a southwest stair descending under the floor; a broad north stair rises behind a waist-high black-stone threshold table. At the center, a broad-bodied fasting champion lies on the dais under padded cloth and slack copper anchor wires while mixed-build furnace workers in layered wool, leather aprons, gloves, and soot scarves check racks. Ember light from the east meets cold teal reflection from the trough.

visible_characters.default_stance: reclined on the central fitting dais beneath slack anchor wires
distributed among rack aisles and furnace mouths performing ordinary setup

visual_continuity_notes: The east furnace wall, central fitting dais, south quench trough, north threshold table and stair, and southwest under-gallery stair keep the same relative positions in every court frame.
The court is one large working room beneath a Crown City, not the whole Ninth Furnace arcology.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Medium view at the north threshold table looking south into the furnace court. On the south court side, Melka, a sturdy middle-aged woman with medium-brown skin, cropped black hair streaked silver, an ash-gray hooded wool mantle, clay-red tunic, leather document satchel, and ink-stained fingers, braces both hands on a rectangular brass-bound blackwood answer-roll case. Across from her on the north stair side sits Taru, an older broad-faced man with deep-brown skin, close gray beard, ochre quilted coat, green wool scarf, household wax tablet, and three dense travel cakes; the exit stair rises behind him. Nema, a slim adult clerk with copper-brown skin, long dark braid, indigo layered robe, bronze stylus, and wax tablets, stands at the table's east end with her stylus above the case seal. Behind Melka the central fitting dais, east furnaces, south trough, and southwest stair remain visible. The mood is routine, watchful, and almost companionable.

visual_continuity_notes: The answer-roll case remains under Melka's hands unless a later ending moves it.
Taru is placed with the north stair at his back and the south trough in view.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Pivotal close view of the south-wall quench trough at first horn. Black mineral water rises above its normal stone lip and forms a translucent human-like face beneath a square iron drain grate. A watery hand touches its thumb to two knuckles, then opens toward the sealed brass-bound blackwood answer-roll case visible on the north threshold table in the far background. Taru, an older man in ochre coat and green scarf, freezes in profile near the table; Melka, a sturdy middle-aged woman in ash-gray mantle and clay-red tunic, keeps both hands on the case; Nema, a slim indigo-robed registrar, stands rigid beside them. East-furnace ember light and cold teal water light pull in opposite directions. The face is materially strange, incomplete, and solemn.

global_branch_image_modifiers.modifier_prompt: A freshly copied waxed-cloth roll lies beside Taru's household tablet with every correction visibly preserved as a second mark.
Melka and Sedren stand along three white chalk bars connecting trough lip, maintenance throat, and southwest stair; Sedren points only to the stone-and-water route.
Nema copies three distinct seal impressions while Melka keeps the brass-bound case on her side of the threshold table.
A broken travel cake and empty cup sit beside Taru; his stance is steady and the exit stair remains clear behind him.
Melka cuts the mortuary cord immediately while Taru and the brown-cloaked delver both watch; the uncovered trough face remains visible on the same diagonal.
A fitted basalt slab covers the south trough; a cold teal line leaks beneath it toward freshly reinforced chalk marks and the southwest stair.
A brown-cloaked delver carries a sealed document tube up the north stair, visibly beyond the threshold attendants.
Nema's bronze stylus points to mortuary cord, household wax, delver mark, and unbroken hinge while Melka retains the case.
Melka and Taru mark one open-palm warning sign on the request leaf; Orsa repeats the act toward the dais while leaving the identity space blank.
Vael places one small dark interval counter beside the hostel and shrine withdrawal leaves; the south trough glows more strongly while Taru holds a palm outward in refusal.
The request leaf carries an open path turning away from the fitting dais; Taru stands angled toward the north stair while Nema records a visible hesitation mark.
Melka places Sedren's three chalk route marks beside the request entry; Sedren's gloved hand rests on the heavy counterweight brake.
Melka and Taru occupy dry stone ledges, the brown-cloaked delver holds a clear stair mouth above them, and one water face touches the roll edge before falling.
Quench water surges across the ledge, Taru braces against the stair wall, one wax correction washes pale, and furnace heat crosses the uppermost chalk mark.
Three wet hand-shaped marks stop at Sedren's dry chalk boundary while suspended iron scales remain arrested above Daro.
The delver waits higher on the north stair with a sealed tube, so original, household copy, and outside copy form three visible custody points.
Iron descends in clean marked order; the trough holds low beneath visible chalk routes; the request leaf changes subtly while every witness remains at a distinct station.
Quench water streams upward in thin ribbons and several incomplete ash faces form around Daro: one makes Taru's gesture, one faces the north stair, and one mouth shapes Orsa's offered terms.

occluders.effect: Racks partially block the direct centerline; the east-side sightline remains open from threshold to trough.
When closed, it blocks sight and speech between the north stair and court but does not block wet impact sounds through stone.
The fitted slab hides the water surface while cold leakage, knocks, and route effects can remain visible or audible at its edges.

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable named-character and group visual identities for prompt assembly. Include only refs for characters or groups visible in a scene.

characters.melka: Melka: sturdy middle-aged human woman, medium-brown skin, cropped black hair streaked silver, square attentive face, ash-gray hooded wool mantle over clay-red layered tunic, narrow leather document satchel, ink-stained fingers, compact cord knife, brass-bound blackwood answer-roll case usually under both hands; posture precise, protective, and physically aware of exits.
characters.taru: Taru: older human man, broad face, deep-brown skin, close gray beard, ochre quilted wool coat, faded green scarf, household wax tablet and wrapped travel cakes; heavy tired hands, grief held as exact correction, open-palm and two-knuckle gesture performed once.
characters.nema: Nema: slim adult human woman, copper-brown skin, long dark braid, narrow alert face, indigo layered clerk's robe with plain bronze fasteners, bronze stylus and stacked wax tablets; hands kept near records but visibly clear of the mortuary case unless invited.
characters.sedren: Sedren: broad heavy-set adult human man, umber skin, shaved head, old pale heat scars on both forearms, charcoal leather apron over thick brown wool, heavy gloves, white route chalk and iron brake tools; grounded stance oriented to stone, water, racks, and machinery.
characters.vael: Vael: slight older human man, tawny skin, shaved temples with one long dark braid, layered gray wool robe, wooden counting board, separate wax grant leaves, small iron reserve case; economical movement and eyes fixed on counting marks and material costs.
characters.orsa: Orsa: tall adult human woman, dark skin, shaved sides with braided crown, severe iron-thread mantle over plain black tunic, broad iron ring at throat, empty hands; ceremonial stillness directed between threshold claimant and fitting dais, lit only by ember furnaces and cold teal water.
characters.daro: Daro: broad-bodied adult human man, deep tan skin, shaved scalp, padded dark fitting cloth around torso and limbs, slack copper anchor wires laid across the padding, bare hands watched by healers; fasting fatigue visible in cheekbones and controlled breath.

groups.court_workers: Ninth Furnace court workers: mixed ages, skin tones, and builds in layered soot-dark wool, leather aprons, heat gloves, cloth head wraps, and practical boots; healers wear pale washable aprons; branch attendants wear dark layered wool with hooked utility blades; each body occupies a rack, furnace, threshold, or patient-care station.
groups.delver_witness: Independent delver witness: one adult human of compact build in a weathered brown travel cloak, gray wool underlayers, practical boots, leather gloves, and a rigid sealed document tube; posture keeps a clear stair route and gaze fixed on the custody handoff.

review_notes: The visual plan carries a fixture-level scene_set map with fixed zones, camera slots, staging slots, route lanes, and occluders; generated images remain painterly replay collateral rather than geometry authority.
All base prompts restate visible room geometry, materials, lighting, bodies, objects, and character appearance without relying on prior generated frames or private Kalsa terminology.
Branch modifiers describe visible changes to record custody, route marks, witness support, request type, stopped machinery, water behavior, and divine armament state.
The exact character appearances and court plan are local visual design for this fixture, not canonical Kalsan phenotype, universal Jamnai architecture, or a selected Ash-Halo outcome.
